testcase.name: Given no initial story and 3 records with 2nd is not viewed, when I initialize, then I expect storyIndex to be 1
Given first page and first post, when I goToPreviousPost, then I expect storyIndex to be 0
Given no initial story and 3 records with 1st and 3rd not viewed, when I goToNext, then I expect storyIndex to be 2
Given a single story, when I goToPrevious, then I expect storyIndex to be -1
Given no unread and jump to next unread enabled, when I goToNext, then I expect storyIndex to be size
Given no initial story and 3 records all not viewed, when I initialize, then I expect storyIndex to be 0
Given no initial story and 3 records all viewed, when I initialize, then I expect storyIndex to be 0
Given first page and second post, when I goToPreviousPost, then I expect storyIndex to be 0
